title: Authentication Overview
description: Understand authentication vs authorization in Web APIs.

data.text: **Authentication** verifies who you are. **Authorization** determines what you can access. Both are essential for secure APIs.

data.caption: Authentication and authorization flow in a Web API

terms.definition: Verifying user identity using tokens, cookies, or credentials
Controlling access to resources based on roles or policies
A credential presented in API calls to prove identity
A piece of information asserted about the user

data.title: Configuring Authentication

items: Common schemes: JWT, OAuth, API Keys

data.title: Explore Authentication in a Sample API
data.description: Create a new ASP.NET Core Web API project and examine its default authentication configuration.
steps: Look for any authentication or authorization service registrations
Try adding a JWT bearer token scheme
data.expectedOutcome: You should see the default API template and understand where authentication services are configured.

items.text: Understand the difference between authentication and authorization
Know common authentication schemes (JWT, OAuth, API Keys)
Can explain why both auth and authz are needed
Recognize token-based authentication in ASP.NET Core

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Secure APIs require both authentication and authorization.
